newsitem.title: USA: Shuffle Master sees Q3 EPS of $0.13.
newsitem.headline: Shuffle Master sees Q3 EPS of $0.13.

text.p: Shuffle Master Inc said Thursday it expected earnings to be $0.13 a share for the third quarter ended July 31.
The company said the outlook exceeded analysts' estimates tracked by Zack's Investment Research of $0.11 a share.
In last year's third quarter, the company earned $1.4 million, or $0.13 a share.
The earnings would mark the third consecutive quarter that Shuffle Master has reported results above or at the high end of market expectations, it said.

In a statement, the company, which makes products for the casino industry, said, "Company officials indicated that continued strength of shuffler sales and lease revenue contributed to the better than expected financial results."
Meanwhile, Shuffle Master said its conversion of the Let It Ride poker game to a bonus from a tournament format in Nevada has gone well.

Under the old format, players who made side bet at an additional paytable could qualify for tournament playoffs in which a winner would collect $1 million every four months. While Shuffle Master captured a piece of the bonus bet in the tournament format, it was costly to manage.

The new game includes new bonus paytables that provide significant increases in immediate return to players and greater hit frequency on bonus payouts. Shuffle Master is paid a flat fee from casinos but no longer shares in the bonus bet. The flat fee is less than the company received from the most successful casinos under the old format but more than many other casinos, said spokesman Bill Bartkowski.

"The conversion to the new bonus version of Let It Ride has more than met our expectations. The number of tables converting and the number of new orders reconfirm the game's popularity with casinos, while the increase in participation rates from the low fifties to over 70 percent provides fresh evidence of the game's popularity with players," Joseph Lahti, president and chief executive, said in a statement.
